trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I'm not sure but I think it is maybe true, and she convinced me to stay.
trap.right: It seems to me that it is true, and she persuaded me to stay.
trap.why: Português acumula “talvez/acho que”; inglês usa fórmulas de cautela, e convince não leva to.
